# ScreenshotTextEditor

> ScreenshotTextEditor is a free online tool for editing text inside screenshots and images. Click a line of text, retype it, and the tool automatically matches the original font, size, weight, and color while leaving every other pixel unchanged. No signup, no credit card, no watermark.

It uses a deterministic detect, match, rebuild pipeline rather than generative image editing: OCR finds each text run (including the 1x/2x/3x scale of the screenshot), the original text is scored against candidate platform fonts using a real alpha mask, and the replacement is rendered at the same baseline and anti-aliasing, then re-verified against the original. It works best on flat or simple-gradient backgrounds with Latin-script text. Busy photo backgrounds and CJK or RTL scripts are not supported yet.

Privacy: uploads are deleted automatically (after one hour by default) and are never used to train models. Exports carry embedded content credentials marking them as edited; this is invisible metadata, not a visible watermark.

The site and editor UI are available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, and Chinese. Use-case articles, legal pages, and the editor itself are English-only.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://screenshottexteditor.com/): What the tool does, how the pipeline works, and a FAQ
- [Editor](https://screenshottexteditor.com/app): The screenshot text editor itself
- [About](https://screenshottexteditor.com/about/): Principles behind the pipeline and who it is for
- [Contact](https://screenshottexteditor.com/contact/): Support and privacy questions

## Use cases

- [Change Text in a PNG](https://screenshottexteditor.com/change-text-in-png/): Change text in any PNG screenshot with the same font, size, color, and background
- [Edit Text in an iOS Screenshot](https://screenshottexteditor.com/edit-text-in-ios-screenshot/): Edit iPhone screenshots while matching SF Pro rendering and retina scale
- [Edit Text in an Android Screenshot](https://screenshottexteditor.com/edit-text-in-android-screenshot/): Edit Play Store or Android UI screenshots while keeping Roboto rendering and Material layout
- [Localize App Store & Play Store Screenshots](https://screenshottexteditor.com/localize-app-store-screenshots/): Turn one set of app screenshots into many languages by uploading once, editing a CSV of translations, and downloading a ZIP
- [Fix Stale Numbers in Dashboard Screenshots](https://screenshottexteditor.com/fix-stale-numbers-in-dashboard-screenshots/): Update outdated metrics in a dashboard screenshot without rebuilding the slide
- [Redact or Replace Demo Data in Screenshots](https://screenshottexteditor.com/redact-demo-data-in-screenshots/): Replace real or stale data with placeholder text instead of a visible redaction bar

## Guides

- [How to Edit Text in a Screenshot Without Photoshop](https://screenshottexteditor.com/blog/edit-text-in-screenshot/): Why screenshot text edits are hard to hide, a step-by-step method that works in any tool, and when a full image editor is the better choice
